description: Going Commando's Charge Boots charge on Clank's Thruster-Pack, running Going Commando's own code: with the Thruster-Pack on, double-tap R1 and hold to charge, steering with the stick; flames turn blue and enemies in the way are hit. Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.23 or later.

screenshots.caption: A charge down a tunnel on Clank's Thruster-Pack, its flames blue.

videos.caption: Charges on Clank's Thruster-Pack down rain-soaked streets, its flames blue.
